verdict.rationale: Vue.js is a JavaScript UI framework used entirely through code. It has no operator-facing product UI or dashboard whose actions could be mirrored by a separate API, so the API/UI parity question is a category error for this product type. The 404 OpenAPI probe and the 'intuitive API' docs claim concern the framework's programming interface, not UI-to-API parity, so they do not make the axis applicable.
